page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Above the text, a block of two numbered theses in italic. A narrow strip of cropped margin text runs down the right edge; it is too cut off to read.

main_text.l: 14. Juramenti illiciti, & juramenti de re illicita discrimen.
Juramentum in genere, quid in spe-
quibus sc. petendae sunt, & ad quas exi-
rim, antequam id faciam, non jam exo-
ratum eo, (quod facerem si aut suspecta
mihi esset vestra humanitas, aut res ipsa
non est multo justissima :) sed praemo-
esse, dum reperiam quod rei de qua a-
verbis non ultra laborare, multo minus
follicitum esse. Curent ista scilicet, qui-
bus vacat, & cordi est, negotium fa-cessere

page.notes: The narrow strip of margin text at the right edge is cropped and cannot be read; it is not transcribed. The Greek word after "Canones &" is not legible letter by letter. The Greek word after "quasdam" is uncertain. The numbered theses at the top are transcribed as paragraphs, not headings. The catchword "cessere" is the completion of "fa-" at the line end. A small mark at the left of the catchword line is not transcribed.
